outcome.en: Replaces dozens of static Compose previews with one runtime environment for exploring UI configurations.
outcome.el: Αντικαθιστά δεκάδες static Compose previews με ένα runtime περιβάλλον εξερεύνησης UI configurations.

contribution.en: I designed a single wrapper and control panel for theme, locale, font scale, RTL, dynamic color, bold text and high contrast.
contribution.el: Σχεδίασα ένα wrapper και control panel για theme, locale, font scale, RTL, dynamic color, bold text και high contrast.

detail.en: CompositionLocal overrides apply changes while the screen runs; rememberSaveable keeps the selected configuration across recreation.
detail.el: CompositionLocal overrides εφαρμόζουν τις αλλαγές όσο τρέχει η οθόνη, ενώ το rememberSaveable διατηρεί το configuration μετά από recreation.

proof.en: 40 preview combinations reduced to one interactive wrapper
proof.el: 40 preview combinations σε ένα interactive wrapper
